Name: PinkStations Cotton Candy Recolor
Author: PinkStations
Description:
[b][size=5]~PinkStations Cotton Candy Recolor~[/size]
[/b]
[size=3]A pretty recolor based on bright & cute colors! [/size]

[size=3]This mod recolors all of the base grass, dirt, rocks, etc. as well as buildings, mini-maps, foliage, and most of the other elements including festival stalls and such. Basically, If it's visible outside I probably colored it![/size]

[size=3][u][b]NEW[/b] Configurability update 2.0!![/u][/size]
[size=3]I have spent a lot of time on this and am happy to finally share the configurability update! All aspects of this mod are now fully configurable! [/size]

[size=3]What does that mean? Well it means that if you only want the town buildings, you can turn only the town buildings on and the rest will stay vanilla colors. Or say you love the recolor but don't like the water? You can turn off the water and go back to vanilla blue water with the rest still colored. You could turn off the entire recolor if you wanted (although I'm not sure [i]why[/i] you'd download just to turn it completely off but hey, it's your game)[/size]

[size=3]Please see the README.txt document for all configurability options and descriptions![/size]

[size=3]I'm also going to leave the original version of this mod up as an alternate download for anyone who may still want it, I did have to sacrifice some small seasonal elements in the name of configurability (and my sanity) so if you'd like the mod as it was with all of those tiny details it is still here for you.[/size]

[size=3]If you were previously using this mod please delete the old version and replace it with the new as the structure has changed completely.[/size]

[size=4][b]Currently Compatible With:
